name: lookout_aims_and_bounces
description: Targeting (design 3.2): the Hawk Roost prefers winged creeps, picking a Duskmoth over a Gourdling further along and leaving a ground target the moment a moth comes into reach. The Kestrel Flock's strikes bounce on to 2 more creeps, each within 1.2 tiles of the one before and never one the strike already hit (FIRE says which creep a bounce leaves from, HIT its bounce number), and never to a creep further off.

steps.msg: the Hawk Roost hunts the Duskmoth, though the Thornback is further along
with no flier in reach it takes the Thornback
and drops it the moment a Duskmoth is back in reach

steps.assert: scene.bouncing() > 0 and scene.checkpoint(2) == bytes and scene.record_differences(1, 2) == []
steps.msg: a checkpoint with a bounce in the air round-trips
and the loaded copy goes on in step

steps.assert: chain[0] >= 2 and chain[0] == chain[1] and chain[1] == chain[2]
steps.msg: every strike on the first Thornback bounces to the next, 0.8 tiles back, then to the third

steps.assert: scene.events_where('FIRE', {'from': c[0], 'target': c[1]}).size() == chain[0] and scene.events_where('FIRE', {'from': c[1], 'target': c[2], 'form': 'kestrel_flock'}).size() == chain[0]
steps.msg: each bounce is a FIRE from the creep it leaves
three hits a strike, never twice on one creep, never on the Thornback 1.9 tiles off
